Repopulate the [b]entire galaxy[/b] with Dinkys and fully [b]automate everything[/b] with Machines so that the Dinkys can live their lives in peace!


Play [u]solo[/u] or with up to [u]4 friends[/u] in this fun Colony-Building, Automation, Defense adventure

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349040/Dinky_Guardians/


Interested in the behind the scenes? Watch my devlogs to see how the game came to be!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzDRvYVwl53ueGEHkpRtO9e-7QZDHNcfa


[b]Thanks and I hope you like the game![/b]
- Hugo (Code Monkey, Endless Loop Studios)

notes.title: My next game, Total World Liberation, wishlist now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177230/Total_World_Liberation/
[previewyoutube=08N85yARCMo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]They have taken over everything, it's up to you to LIBERATE the entire world![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/4799d3bd407cd877caa1969ba0b1351fd3a0482d.gif[/img]

* Find other [b]Survivors [/b]and bring them with you.
* [b]Build [/b]your base with a Workshop, Generator, Houses and plenty of [b]Defenses and Traps![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/dd7cbbeb3af23274fd65c6ead45e5f4904cf3f8b.gif[/img]

* Split up into [b]multiple teams[/b] and explore different areas, don't forget to bring [b]enough ammo[/b] when you leave your base!
* Set up outposts to [b]gather resources [/b]in far away lands and Transport them back to your base through[b] Automated machines,[/b] ensure the Zombies don't destroy your logistics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/c0c59f2340ef79f735d54daf64ea3e2d6674133c.gif[/img]

* Turn-Based so you can take your time to think and come up with the [b]perfect Strategy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32978864/a141b0ffa70b7acb86963690902db36a487761f9.gif[/img]

* [b]Ambush[/b] Zombies and take them all out without suffering casualties
* Be careful when exploring at [b]night[/b], and be even more careful so you don't attract a [b]massive horde![/b]

Start just with [b]one[/b] Survivor and [b]Liberate the entire World![/b]

notes.title: Challenges Mode! - v1.05 - 15/08/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/a7fb639d9028d34e8851957447c83686988fc8ad.gif[/img]
Howdy folks!

[b]Challenges Mode![/b]
Challenge yourself and climb the leaderboards in these cool unique challenges!
Use your own custom sprites or grab some cool ones from the Workshop and make yourself unique on the leaderboards!


[h1]Challenge: Archer Surround[/h1]
Dodge as many arrows as you can!

[h1]Challenge: Bleeding[/h1]
Take out as many enemies as possible!
Your health is constantly dropping
Charge your combo and heal yourself

[h1]Challenge: Provide Support[/h1]
Protect your minions!
Score increases for each friendly Minion that is alive

[h1]Challenge: Super Self[/h1]
Survive for as long as you can!
Attack and counters are disabled
Grab the pick ups to charge your combo and unleash SUPER SELF on your enemies


This is the first in a series of DLC, some paid and some [b]Free,[/b] that will be released in the coming weeks. 
I have loads of ideas on how I can expand upon the core gameplay and will be adding them as interesting new challenges. Stuff like crafting, gathering, complex sieges, customizable minion behaviour, new unit types, wide open persistent areas, castle defense surveillance, expanded knight duels, stealth, etc.
So if you have any comments as to something you'd like to see implemented in the game please let me know, I'm always looking for feedback.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/694200/Hyper_Knights__Challenges/

Right now the challenges are single player only since the current multiplayer implementation is kind of stuck together with duct tape. I plan to refactor a lot of code and see if I can find a way to easily add multiplayer to every challenge.

Next week stay tuned for a free challenge called [b]"Minion Football!"[/b]

Hope you like the new content!
Cheers!

notes.title: Multiplayer update! - v1.02 - 10/06/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/0cef9bf2f02a19817e4edb19f84530e0302c1cf5.gif[/img]
Howdy folks!

The most requested feature, [b]Multiplayer,[/b] is finally here!

Fight alongside a friend and defend your buildings!
Pick your upgrades and fight wisely, higher hit counter equals higher score!

It is currently in [b]Beta[/b] so please let me know if you find something odd. This has been a monumental task so I really need your help to make sure it is rock solid.

Once I am confident that the multiplayer foundation is solid I can start looking into other game modes like Campaign Co-op, 4 Player Defense on a more complex Castle map, PVP mode and so on.

Hope you have fun!
Cheers!

--------

notes.title: Confetti and Steam Friends! - v1.01 - 23/05/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/daf52702580b6a2236db9b6aeb8f911db3bb4e0c.gif[/img]
Howdy folks!

[b]Steam Friends[/b] integration! Now the Knights names can be pulled from your friends, you can choose to pick from all your friends or just those you played with recently (90 days).

Lots of bug fixing and minor features added these past few days like a more polished Battle Results window, support for changing tabs in the Options menu with arrow keys, added Retreat option, etc.

I've also been researching [b]multiplayer[/b] since it is the most requested feature and it appears to be viable so I'm now going to look into getting it to work. Stay tuned!

Cheers!

--------

v1.01 - 23/05/2017

 * Added confetti to Battle Victory Results!
 * Added Steam Friends integration to Knight names
 * Added Retreat option
 * Twitch: Added Screamer
 * Knight names are now always visible
 * Rebalanced early game to be easier to make progress until 3 regions
 * Player now has a different color in Battle Results
 * Reduced max timer on Super Self from 20 to 15
 * Fixed Player Stun/Counter priority stunning same unit when others were around
 * Fixed bug where Village Battle would end and not be destroyed while using Super Self
 * Fixed Flurry animation aiming in the wrong direction


v1.00b - 21/05/2017

 * Added Workshop showcase
 * Added last save name and date to Overmap Menu
 * Added Warning if Steam failed to initialize
 * Added Warning if loading a broken save
 * Now correctly refreshes the game when you subscribe to an item on the Workshop
 * Knight intro now closes the Map when triggered
 * Disabled closing map during Tutorial
 * Fixed highlighted unit losing highlight when Knight Skill random health buttons triggered
 * Fixed New Game+ Achievement not triggering
 

v1.00a - 20/05/2017
 
 * Added Options menu change tab with left and right
 * Expanded Twitch integration to include gold and experience drops

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/3726802d3dbc092961e9aef5036ded3e34795fbd.gif[/img]
Howdy folks!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/a9b6b2b9192cce434bdf429b56756f44832c9a71.gif[/img]
[b]Overmap Buildings! [/b]
Construct these structures to help you grow your empire.

[b]Trebuchet[/b] - Attacks nearby enemies and provides support while in battle
[b]Safehouse[/b] - Recruits units willing to join your cause and sends them to the nearest Castle
[b]Mine[/b] - Generates Gold and sends a Convoy to the nearest Castle

Added some specific events that should make the mid-late game more interesting.

Also performance improvements especially in late-game, previously taking 40ms now only 2ms.

Cheers!

notes.title: New Overmap, more battle maps, more environments! - v0.15 - 28/04/2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27853389/d2ba8f365622e16445b289db866bcf93ec1d0ac1.gif[/img]
The new [b]Overmap[/b] is here! It is bigger, 12 new Battle maps and 3 visual environment types!

Performance was terrible with such a large map which caused me to work on many things cutting down save times from 30 seconds to 20 milliseconds!
Also several performance improvements while in battle.

Many small tweaks to make the game balanced and compelling but I need your feedback with regards to the new map. Is it too hard? Too large? Please let me know!

Cheers!

 * Fixed overmap units going over water

notes.title: Improved Overmap AI! - v0.09 - 17/03/2017
notes.content:
Improved Overmap AI!

Enemies and friendlies will now attack nodes and take over regions. They will also request help from nearby Knights when attacking a node with a lot of units.
Destroyed nodes will be repaired after some time.

This should make the entire world feel much more dynamic.

Also added a highlight to the current target and slightly tweaked how that target is chosen. Now it should be easier to attack the same target and when several enemies group up you can hopefully hit all the correct buttons.

Cheers!

----------

notes.title: Minion upgrades! - v0.08 - 10/03/2017
notes.content:
Introducing Minion upgrades!

Level 2 are a bit stronger, Level 3 are quite a lot stronger, have an extra health button and unique skills!

Minions throw a rock that stuns whoever it hits.
Archers fire 3 arrows in quick succession that are slightly guided towards their target.
Shielders have a charge where they knockback and stun units.

Currently the friendly minions don't use skills and their level is always somewhat lower than the enemies, in the future it will be manually upgraded by the player.

As always I'm looking for feedback, especially in regards to difficulty, I want the game to have a smooth difficulty curve. The level of the minions is dependent on the defense of the node, node type and currently owned regions.
So do let me know if you find the new minions too strong/weak.

Thanks!
 

-------

 * Minion Upgrades! Level 2 are stronger, Level 3 are even stronger and have unique skills!

 * Added a potential fix for neverending battle results window

 * Main health bar now flashes when low
 * While in Tutorial Combo time now slows down to 2% instead of 10%
 * Knight Intro no longer plays if Knight is dead
 * Fixed bug when all CapturePoints were taken but Knight was still alive
